subject.text: My report file is gone, is the disk broken?

description.text: The file 'Laporan Kas September' suddenly disappeared from the Desktop.
Yesterday afternoon I tidied up the Desktop and deleted a lot of old files.
The laptop starts normally and other files open fine.

history.text: Technician's search result: the file is in the Recycle Bin (trash), deleted yesterday at 16.05.
Two weeks ago: routine check, disk healthy.

explanation: The file is not lost because of a fault; it was deleted when Fitri tidied up her Desktop and is still in the Recycle Bin. Guide Fitri to get it back by right-clicking it and choosing Restore.
hints: What did Fitri do the day before the file went missing?
Deleted files usually go to the trash first. Look at the technician’s search result.
